set.lowcost.d: Turnarounds without catering, refuelling during boarding, short briefing
set.tankering.d: Low-cost only: no refuelling on the turnaround, the fuel was carried from the origin
set.fuel_first.d: Refuelling is finished before boarding starts (not with low-cost operations)
set.skip_briefing.d: No crew briefing step in the sequence
set.gpu.d: Brings a GPU if none is there; once the APU runs, the ground crew offers to disconnect and removes it when you switch external power off. Zibo/LevelUp 737, ToLiss, X-Crafts E-Jets.
set.gpu_xcrafts.d: Off: SLM leaves the GPU of the X-Crafts E-Jets to you (aircraft menu).
set.people.d: Fewer people on foot at once, for modest computers: they come out a few at a time. The passenger count stays right.
gpu.wait_apu: Connected. Ground will offer to disconnect once the APU is running
gpu.wait_off: Switch external power off to release the GPU

set.event_chance.d: Chance of an event during the ground operations
set.music.d: Plays a .wav file (16-bit PCM) during boarding. Put your files in Resources/plugins/SimLoadManager/lua/SLM-Data/Music/

placement.ui.title: Vehicle placement editor
placement.ui.no_partner: {vehicle} has no Belt loader / Container loader to work with.
placement.ui.people_hint: Vehicles stay visible, faded. People are edited per stand configuration.
placement.ui.select_hint: Select a vehicle, a point or a person in the list or on the map.
placement.ui.heading: Heading
placement.ui.entry_delay: Delay at the entry point: the vehicle appears there and waits before driving off
placement.ui.route_hint: “+” on a segment inserts a waypoint. Only place points: the path (arcs at the turning radius and straight lines) is computed. Round handle on the map = heading, grey when automatic; drag it to force it.
placement.ui.reversed_hint: This vehicle is towed by a tractor and is placed in reverse: end its arrival with a Reverse segment (the boom goes in first), otherwise it loops to turn around. The tractor unhitches it and leaves, then comes back alone to take it away.
placement.ui.heading_title: Heading at this point: automatic (follows the path) or forced. Click to switch; drag the round handle on the map to set it.
placement.ui.seg_toggle: Direction of travel on this segment: click to switch between forward and reverse
placement.ui.test_vehicle: Test this vehicle in the sim
placement.ui.test_vehicle_hint: Only this vehicle drives its arrival route in X-Plane; click again to see it leave.
placement.ui.work_height_hint: Door or hold sill height. The platform rises once the vehicle is in place and comes down before it leaves.
placement.ui.max_carts_hint: The train brings as many as the flight's cargo needs, up to this number.
placement.ui.stairs_height_hint: Door sill height: the stairs landing rises to it once the stairs are in place.
placement.ui.mirror_linked: Linked to {id}: both doors move together.
placement.ui.label: Name
placement.ui.point_hint: Drag the point on the map (Points tab) to move it.
placement.ui.flow_hint: Drag the start point and the waypoints on the map.
placement.ui.no_stairs_flow: Choose the stairs or ambulift the passengers walk to.
placement.ui.flow_no_points: Straight line: use + Point to add waypoints, then drag them on the map.
placement.issue.flow_stairs: {config}: the passenger flow at door {flow} no longer has stairs. Choose stairs in the People tab.
placement.ui.prefill: Pre-fill with the SLM default layout
placement.ui.new_hint: The file is created at the first Save, in SimLoadManager/profiles/.
placement.ui.new_blank_d: Nothing but the aircraft points: no vehicles, no passenger flows, no staff.
placement.ui.realign: Realign on the points of this aircraft
placement.ui.add_hint: Placed facing the point, with default paths. Adjust them on the map.
placement.ui.replace_hint: Keeps the position, the served point and the paths.
placement.ui.drop_hint: Received a .slmprofile? Put it in SimLoadManager/profiles/ and reload the aircraft.
placement.ui.datum: Datum: nose · X right · Z aft · metres
placement.ui.pan_hint: Right-drag or Shift + drag: move the map
placement.ui.slow_hint: End of arrival and start of departure, around the final position.
placement.ui.own_stairs_hint: Door sill height. Nothing is shown: the aircraft deploys its own stairs, passengers climb from the rear of this element up to the door.
placement.ui.auto_placed: Placed automatically next to {vehicle} (work link). Only the entry and the exit are chosen.
